entries.text: Apparently. Either that or he was pushed.

entries.text: What? Was Stan involved?

entries.text: That's what we're trying to determine. Stan was with him just prior to the accident.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You're not suggesting he could have done it?
entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: There's been two deaths here in the past 24 hours. Stan's been present before both of them.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, no. That's impossible. Stan Phillips has a degenerative hip disease. There's no way he could even get up to the fourth floor on his own.
entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: What about an elevator?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: Maybe he was helped.

entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: I don't know. The postmortem on Hal Arden, did you get it yet?

entries.text: Can we check and see if it's come in?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: I'm not sure exactly.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Why are they questioning him?

entries.text: It's routine procedure.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Are they gonna want to keep him here?

entries.text: You'll have to ask dr. Grago.

entries.text: God! If my mother was alive.
entries.speaker: Stan's Daughter

entries.text: How am I supposed to handle the whole floor by myself?

entries.text: I don't know, michelle. I have other things to deal with right now.
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.speaker: Nurse Charters

entries.text: Excuse me. Are you the only one on?
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: Yes! Upshaw never showed up for work last night. I mean, nobody's ever listening to me around here. I said there was something going on, and I told you it had to do with mr. Arden and mr. Phillips. Just forget it.
entries.speaker: Nurse Charters

entries.text: Can you please explain to me what's going on around here?
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: Shoo! Shoo! Go away! Go! Go away! Leave me alone. Go back. Don't come any closer.

entries.text: Go back in your room, Dorothy. If you need something, I'll send an orderly in to see you.
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: Oh, no, no. Th-they're in there.

entries.text: Who?

entries.text: All of them!
entries.speaker: Dorothy

entries.text: There's nobody in your room, Dorothy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Here they come! You'll see. All right, now. You be nice. I don't want any more of your dirty tricks.
entries.speaker: Dorothy

entries.text: Is she gonna be all right? Mm-hmm.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No! No, no, no. I don't want to go back in there. [ grunting ] no! No, I don't want--
entries.speaker: Dorothy

entries.text: It's senile dementia. This is just an episode.
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: You leave her be. D-d-don't you touch her! Now, shoo! Go 'way, go 'way, go 'way! Don't you get any ideas, mister.

entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: Mulder--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, not necessarily. This is only a trace amount. But small amounts have been known to cause hallucinations, which is what one of your patients is having right now.

entries.text: [ knocking at door ]

entries.text: But where did they get it?
entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.speaker: Nurse Charters

entries.text: Oh, my god!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That's fantastic.

entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: Leo? It's incredible.

entries.text: Upshaw.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Why were you growing them?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: For medicinal purposes.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: Were you feeding them to the residents here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yes, but only in small amounts.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: Why?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Because it makes them feel better.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: Exactly what kind of mushrooms are they?
entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: It's from my prefecture, in my country. They've been used for centuries.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: For what purpose?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: In my country, our customs are different.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: You're not in your country now. You're hired here to care for these people under our guidelines.
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: Where I come from, many generations live under one roof. As children, our grandparents live with us. We feel a duty to take care of them. It isn't like that in this country. We respect our old people as we respect our ancestors. We don't send them away to die, like Stan and Hal.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: These people are given excellent medical care.
entries.speaker: Dr. Grago

entries.text: But they are not treated with respect. Hal's family never came to visit him once. And the orderlies... Treat the residents worse than dogs.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: No one is mistreated here.
entries.speaker: Ms. Dawson

entries.text: You're not here to see.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: All right. Gung. Who killed the orderly? Who buried him in that room?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Something... Has gone very wrong. The mushrooms we take to speak with the dead, to see our ancestors in the spirit world. But the spirit in this place is very angry, and the souls that died here continue to suffer. And now they... Have been awakened.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: Are you saying that a spirit killed this man Upshaw?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yes. They've taken revenge for their mistreatment.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: How are the mushrooms taken?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Dried, mixed with many herbs, made into powder.
entries.speaker: Gung

entries.text: Well, I think the first thing we should do is make sure nobody else takes them. You check on the other patients. Gung, come with me. Let's go.

entries.text: Come in, please. Someone's taken them all.

entries.text: I think you're right, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: About?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What's been happening here is the result of the medication. Not the medication the doctor's been giving them.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, mushrooms aren't medication. They taste good on hamburgers, but they don't raise the dead.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Shamans have been using them for centuries to gain entrance to the spirit world.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I think you've been reading too much carlos castaneda.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: All right, ask any anthropologist, then.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I know, a shaman gets intoxicated, he has... Dreams or hallucinations, and he interprets them. I don't think it's any more magical than that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't know how else to explain what's happening here.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, I think if anything, these mushrooms are a poison to the system. And I think that's what killed Hal Arden.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And raped michelle Charters and killed those two orderlies? Something's been unleashed here, Scully. I don't know how to explain it, but it has something to do with those pills.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Daddy? Daddy, what are you taking? What are you putting in your mouth?
entries.speaker: Stan's Daughter

entries.text: Go away! You go away. Go away! Go away. You leave me-- leave us alone! Go on! Oh, no. You, run. Run while you can. Go on, run! Ru--

entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: In response to the series of unexplained incidents... At the Excelsis Dei convalescent home, the massachusetts department of public health has assumed... All administrative authority at the facility. They have detected trace amounts of ibotenic acid in more than half the residents tested, though these levels have dissipated rapidly. Dr. John Grago has been replaced as head physician at the facility, and his trial use of the drug deprenyl has been suspended. For his admitted part in manufacturing and distributing an illicit substance, Gung bittawon was remanded to the immigration and naturalization service... And is awaiting repatriation to malaysia. There are reportedly no efforts being made to study the mushrooms. The federal government has settled michelle Charters' lawsuit out of court, though no clear blame has been placed. Witnesses to the events have been unreliable, due to dramatic relapses... And a general reversal in their progress with Alzheimer's disease.
